subject: Sandbox padding request while PO moves through procurement
body:
From: Sana Roy <sana@medalign.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Request to avoid sandbox lapse while PO is routing

Hi Neha,

Quick one — procurement finally kicked off our purchase order for Redwood but they said it will be another 6–8 business days to get the formal PO number approved and uploaded into our vendor portal. We still have a live sandbox that the clinical team is testing for the week; if it lapses we lose the momentum on the model evaluation.

Is there a way to keep the sandbox active or get a short token/top-up while procurement finishes the paperwork? We can share the PO screenshot as proof the request is moving.

Thanks,
Sana
Sana Roy
Head of Data Science, MedAlign
--

-----Original Message-----
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Sana Roy <sana@medalign.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:22:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to avoid sandbox lapse while PO is routing

Hi Sana — thanks for the heads up and congrats on getting procurement moving.

We can do a short runway padding while the PO clears. To keep things safe and traceable we usually: 
- Ask for a screenshot or scanned copy of the PO submission (or the confirmation email from procurement).
- Limit the temporary top-up to a defined window (typically 72 hours) or a small token amount tied to the current demo scope.

If you can send the screenshot I’ll route this to our CS operations for an interim 72-hour sandbox extension. If procurement confirms an expected completion date longer than three days, we can instead set a staged 7-day allowance pending finance approval.

Please CC your procurement contact so we have a direct verifier.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Exec — Commercial
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message Follows-----
From: Sana Roy <sana@medalign.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:45:33 -0700
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>; Procurement Team <procurement@medalign.io>
Subject: PO confirmation (screenshot attached)

Thanks Neha — attaching the screenshot of the submission confirmation from our vendor portal. Procurement estimates 7 business days but said they would try to expedite. Procurement contact is Tara Lin (procurement@medalign.io).

Sana

Attachments:
- PO_screenshot.png (image/png)

-----Original Message-----
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Roy <sana@medalign.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 12:10:02 -0700
Subject: RE: Sandbox padding request while PO moves through procurement

Neha — I see the PO screenshot, thanks. A couple of operational notes from my side: 

- For a 3-day emergency extension we can approve an interim token grant tied to the demo environment and log it against deal HD-9921.
- For anything beyond 3 business days we need a brief finance approval (email OK) and the signed PO file uploaded to our S3 intake.
- We should add a short acceptance criterion on the extension: limited to existing demo projects only (no new seats or production data ingestion).

If you want, I can approve 72 hours now and create a follow-up task for finance to review the PO next week.

Jonas
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Sana Roy <sana@medalign.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:32:47 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox padding request while PO moves through procurement

Thanks all — confirming we can issue a 72-hour sandbox padding for MedAlign, logged to HD-9921. 

Action items: 
- Neha: I'll need the PO screenshot uploaded to the deal folder (Drive link above) and a short note from procurement confirming the estimated completion date.
- Jonas: please log the temporary token grant in the cost ledger (internal).
- Sana / Procurement: please upload the signed PO to the vendor intake once available — final billing will only proceed after the PO is in finance.

Neha — I'll send the confirmation email to Sana and provision the tokens after you upload the screenshot to the Drive link.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

--- End of thread ---
